title: DataAug
summary: A collection of machine-learning notebooks and scripts for augmenting manufacturing process data, including laser powder bed fusion (LPBF) and friction stir welding datasets. LPBF_CTGan.py trains a CTGAN model on real process data to generate synthetic samples and evaluates their quality with SDMetrics' QualityReport, directly running the standalone ctgan and sdmetrics packages.
evidence: LPBF/LPBF_CTGan.py: 'from ctgan import CTGAN' and 'from sdmetrics.reports.single_table import QualityReport' with metadata dict and real/synthetic data calls
